rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Citing Article 83(c) and Article 117(2) of the Constitution, the President announces the resignation of the Government of the Russian Federation; the decree enters into force on signing. Signed "Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин", Moscow, Kremlin, 15 January 2020, No. 14.
rows.locator: Preamble; point 1; point 4; signature and date block (PDF page 1)

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The President entrusts the temporary performance of the duties of the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation to D. A. Medvedev.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The President instructs the Government to perform its duties until a new Government of the Russian Federation is formed.
